en: So that's the face of the enemy.\f
Eagle!\fYou're OK!\fThank goodness. (sigh)\f
I... I... Ooooh!\rI am so mad!\fSturm! I can't stand power-hungry\rblockheads like that!\f
You're a bit steamed,\reh, Sami?\f
Captain Drake!\fHow did you...?\f
I got Green Earth all\rstraightened out.\fSo, I thought I'd come\rdeliver my army.\f
These Green Earth troops?\fI can use them?\f
Naturally!\fI deployed this group\respecially for you!\f
All right, everybody!\fLet's move out!\f
No one...ever listens...to me.\rI told you...you can't...win.\fThank you...for trying.\f
I never shoulda left her alone...\f
We can't afford to lose!\f
You will feel my wrath!\f
My precious keepsake, Sonja.\fI will protect you with\rmy life.\f
I've got to do my best here.\rI can't let Eagle down!\f
This is getting interesting.\fI was losing my edge\rfighting that darned clone!\f
We can't let our guards down.\f
Those fools...\fTheir troops are all amassed\rright there...\fBwah ha ha... They've played\rright into my hands!\fThey'll rue the day they dreamed\rof opposing me!\f
Sturm's proving to be\ra dangerous enemy.\fBut if we all work together,\rI know we can win!\fLet's take him!\f

Nooooooooooo!\fSo close, I was so close...\fI underestimated the strength\rof these worms!\fI...I've been beaten!\fMy dream of world conquest...\fI vow that I will return!\fWhen that time comes, I will\rchallenge you worms yet again!\f
Yahoo!\fI think that about wraps things up!\fThanks, Grit!\f
Yeah, not a bad day's work, Maxie.\rFor you!\f
You wanna start somethin'?\fShould we settle this right\rhere and now?\f
Ha, ha, ha, ha!\fHow's that?\rDid you see my display?\fI paid back Sturm in kind for\rdaring to deceive me!\f
I think you just caused a peck\ra trouble with all that snow, Boss.\f
What was that, Grit?\fOh, who cares? It's a grand day!\fHa, ha, ha, ha, ha!\f
Well, it's not like he's got any\rbad intentions.\f
I do believe we've reached the\rend of a long, dusty road.\fGoodness gracious!\fIf it ain't my old friend--\rbig, bearded Olaf.\f
Is that you, Grit?\fWhat have I done...?\fI never realized Sturm was...\f
Don't get all long in\rthe face now, Olaf.\fEverything turned out all\rright in the end.\fAnd Boss, you still got\ra lot of work to get done.\f
You...you're right.\f
Blue Moon's treated me well,\rand I'm in her debt.\fWell, what else can I do?\fWhat do you say? Can I help\ryou rebuild her?\f
Hm?\fDo you mean you would\rforgive me my misguided deeds?\fGrit, you...you...(sniff, sniff)\f
Maybe it was worth Sturm\rfoolin' him just for this.\f
Did you say something?\f
Nope. Not a word.\fLet's say we get movin'\ron down the road.\f
Sonja!\fAre you all right?\f
Uh-huh. Thank you, Father.\f
Oh, Sonja...\rIf anything had happened to you...\f
Father! Don't you dare start crying!\f
Bu...but...\f
Really!\fUm, Father... I truly thank you.\fDo you know what Mother\rused to tell me?\f'Your Father's a bit silly, but he'll\ralways be there when you need him.'\f
(sniff)\fYou look just like her, Sonja.\rYou really do.\f
Did we win?\f
Yeah, this time we really won!\f
And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fAh!\fWhat happened to Eagle?\f
Ahoy, there mateys!\fIt looks like you've weathered the\rstorm! Or should I say, 'Sturm!'\f
Captain Drake!\f
Don't you worry your pretty little\rhead over Eagle.\fHe'll be back.\fHe always keeps his word.\rNo matter what!\f
Yes... Yes, he does!\f

At any rate, you did great!\fBut we've still got\rrough seas ahead of us.\fWe've got to put right the country\rborders that Sturm muddled with.\fIt's going to take some time for\rthe fighting to die down.\f
Do you mean we're not done yet?\f
It's not as bad as all that.\fAt the very least, it'll be fun\rseeing you all again!\f
I think it'll be fun, too!\f
That's a good lad!\fLooking forward to testing your\rmettle again! Until next we meet!\f
Yeah, this time we really won!\f
And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fEagle! Thanks for your help!\f
No thanks are necessary.\fAfter all, much of your hardships\rwere caused by my earlier mistake.\f
Facing you in combat was really\ra tough struggle.\fThere was absolutely no\rmargin for error!\f
Yeah, but it was a ton of fun!\f
For me as well!\fWhy not? Hey, Andy!\fI think I'd like to take\ranother shot at you!\fWhat do you say? Are you\rup for the challenge?\f
Another battle? You know it!\fLet's go!\f
There aren't many\runits here, are there?\f
That's right.\fDo you know what to do?\f
Sure! I just use these bases to\rdeploy whatever troops I want!\f
I guess there's nothing left\rfor me to teach you.\f
I lost again.\rYou're a tough one.\f

Oh, that's right. Orange Star is using\rstrategic advisors.\fThat way, the commanders can just\rconcentrate on the combat itself.\fThat's an impressive system.\rIt's why I couldn't match you in battle.\f
I don't know why, but when we work\rtogether, we're really strong!\f
Yes, indeed.\fThis was your day in the sun.\rBut...\f
Hey! Let's fight again some day.\f
